summary: A 330 m nuclear-style aircraft carrier: a lofted grey hull with a fine bow, bulbous forefoot, red antifouling… joints jbd_1, jbd_2, jbd_3, jbd_4, radar, elevator_1, …; options paint; sockets waterline, seat_driver, eye_point, socket_catapult_1, socket_catapult_2, socket_catapult_3, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.aircraft_carrier or place "prefab": "aircraft_carrier" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
